title: Three Words Free, and One Dot
label: ch:bn-three-words-and-a-dot
canDo: I can read চা, জল and দুধ off the page without learning a single new shape, then write the retroflex ড and the dot that turns it into the flap inside পড়া — the verb for what I am doing.

payoff.summary: The verb for what the reader is doing is read off the page, once the dot beneath ড has turned a retroflex stop into the flap Bengali actually says.
